messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — Token Cost dashboard showing $0 / NaN for a small slice of orgs since ~03:00 UTC. Customers reporting charges but dashboard shows free. Example org_ids: 7301, 9092, 11877. Usage tokens present but cost_usd is null or 0.
Mike: Thanks. Can you paste the query you use for the widget and a small sample row from the underlying table? Also any recent deploys to billing or pricing services last night? @jen FYI.
Ashley: Widget is pulling from token_costs_daily aggregate. Query we use in console (simplified):
```
select org_id, date, usage_tokens, cost_usd
from token_costs_daily
where date >= '2026-03-15'
```
Sample rows from the dashboard DB:
org_id | date       | usage_tokens | cost_usd
7301   | 2026-03-16 | 124500       | NULL
9092   | 2026-03-16 | 45200        | 0.00
11877  | 2026-03-16 | 3200         | NULL
Mike: That looks like a pricing join problem rather than UI. If price is missing, cost calc will be NULL or zero depending on branch. @chris can you check the price cache/price refresh job logs?
Jen: I didn't touch the pricing service last night. But infra ran the pricing sync at 02:45 UTC (cron). If the pricing API returned a 5xx the refresh can write empty price entries to price_cache which downstream joins don't filter. We should guard against that. Quick check: `select count(*) from price_cache where price_usd is null and last_updated >= '2026-03-16'`.
Chris: Confirmed — billing-prices-refresh job (job id billing-prices-refresh-20260316-0245) failed with 502 from pricing-regional-api, fell back to partial write and left ~312 rows with price_usd=NULL. I have the job logs attached to the runbook but pasting key error: `HTTP 502 Bad Gateway from pricing-regional-api/2.1`.
Sophie: Impacted customers: ticket #C-2026-3493 (org 9092) and #C-2026-3498 (org 7301). Both escalated to P1 because invoices showed charges while dashboard showed $0. They asked for ETA.
billing-bot: automated-alert: pricing-refresh job 2026-03-16 02:45 failed -> 502. created incident INC-2026-1132.
Mike: Minimal repro to find affected orgs:
```
select org_id from token_costs_daily
where usage_tokens > 0 and (cost_usd is null or cost_usd = 0)
and date = '2026-03-16';
```
Chris: Proposed remediation steps:
1) Stop the broken refresh and re-run pricing-refresh with `--skip-validate` turned off so we don't commit partial data.
2) Backfill price_cache for affected SKUs from archive pricing snapshots (we have nightly snapshots in s3://redwood-billing/pricing-snapshots/2026-03-16.json).
3) Recompute cost_usd for token_costs_daily for affected orgs/dates and refresh dashboard cache.
Jen: SQL backfill snippet (run on analytics cluster):
```
update price_cache pc
set price_usd = p.price_usd, last_updated = now()
from pricing_snapshots p
where pc.sku = p.sku
and pc.last_updated >= '2026-03-16'
and pc.price_usd is null;
```
Followed by:
```
update token_costs_daily t
set cost_usd = (t.usage_tokens * pc.price_usd)
from price_cache pc
where t.date = '2026-03-16' and t.org_id in (7301, 9092, 11877)
and pc.sku = t.sku;
```
Chris: I ran the backfill on staging and sanity-checked totals vs snapshot. Running on prod now (started 1975007000). ETA ~10m for the recompute for the impacted day.
Ashley: Thanks — please also send a short note to affected customers. I'll update ticket threads. @sophie can you send the customer-facing summary: what happened, what's done, and when dashboard will refresh?
Sophie: Drafting reply: "We identified a failed pricing refresh that left price values null for a limited set of SKUs. We've backfilled price data from nightly snapshots and recomputed costs for the affected dates. Dashboard should show corrected values within 10–15 minutes. We're also adding validation to prevent partial writes in the future." Will paste in ticket comments.
Mike: Postmortem actions: add defensive check in billing-prices-refresh (abort on upstream 5xx), add query-level `coalesce(price_usd, 0)` so UI doesn't show NULL (but still flag zero as an error), add a dashboard alert for mismatch between invoice totals and dashboard totals. I'll open issues.
Ashley: Confirmed — dashboard values updated for the three sample orgs, costs now show expected numbers. Ran the repro query, returned zero rows. Customers notified and happy. Closing loop.
Chris: Follow-up: created PR to pricing-refresh that adds transactional write semantics and a circuit-breaker for upstream 5xx. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/487
Ashley: :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone. Leaving incident INC-2026-1132 as resolved pending postmortem writeup.
